voiceSummary: Azad Engineering Limited has intimated the schedule for analyst and institutional investor meetings under SEBI Listing Regulations. Company officials will attend an investor conference on November 18, 2026, starting at 9:00 am. The event is a one-on-one or group meeting held in person in Mumbai, organized by Avendus Spark. Discussions will be based on publicly available information. No unpublished price sensitive information is intended to be discussed. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies by the host or company. The company requests the exchanges to take this intimation on record.

attchmntText: The link to access the Audio Recording of Earnings Conference Call held on November 7, 2026.
voiceSummary: Azad Engineering Limited has released the audio recording of the earnings conference call for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The call was organized on November 7, 2026, to discuss the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results. The audio file is available at the provided link. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The announcement was issued by G. Praneeth Abhishek, Company Secretary, Compliance Officer, and Head Legal.

attchmntText: Newspaper publications of Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Azad Engineering Limited filed newspaper clippings regarding Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were published in Financial Express and Surya on November 7, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 5, 2026. The document also contains extracts of financial results for other entities including JNK India Limited, Supriya Lifescience Limited, Patel KNR Heavy Infrastructures Limited, and Sundaram Mutual Fund. Sundaram Mutual Fund revised the Risk-o-meter for its schemes pursuant to SEBI circulars. Financial figures are reported in millions or lakhs as specified in the respective extracts.
